picks.title: AMD acquires Taalas to boost inference performance by etching models in silicon
picks.why_it_matters: AMD's acquisition signals a major shift toward custom silicon for AI inference, validating the market for startups building specialized AI hardware and creating potential acqui-hire opportunities in the chip space.

picks.title: Naïve raises $28.5M to automate the grunt work of setting up and running a company
picks.why_it_matters: This round validates investor appetite for 'vibe-coding' infrastructure plays that could dramatically reduce the operational overhead for new startups—a trend that may reshape how founders build companies.

picks.title: Launch HN: ProvenMetal (YC S26) delivers circuit boards in days instead of weeks
picks.why_it_matters: Hardware iteration speed is a persistent bottleneck for deep tech startups; a YC-backed company solving PCB turnaround time signals growing infrastructure support for the hardware renaissance.
